name: neon
description: Manage serverless Postgres on Neon — projects, branches, schemas, SQL, migrations, Neon Auth, the Neon Data API, and docs — through the official remote Neon MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Manage serverless Postgres on Neon through the official Neon MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can manage your Neon Postgres databases — creating projects, branching databases, running SQL queries, applying schema migrations, and fetching connection strings. No more context-switching to the Neon dashboard. Just ask your agent to create a new database branch, run a migration, check query performance, or show you a quick schema overview.
defaultPrompt: Show me my Neon projects and database branches.
Run a SQL query and show me the results.
Help me create a new branch to test a schema migration.
